AI Threat Concerns Grow Amid Calls for Innovation Speed Limits

Leading international news outlets are discussing the escalating threat posed by artificial intelligence, with some opinion pieces suggesting it may already be too late to fully control its development. The discussions highlight the difficulty, both practical and political, in slowing down AI innovation. While specific incidents or policy proposals are not detailed, the coverage broadly reflects a growing concern about the potential dangers of advanced AI and the challenges in managing its rapid progress.
